company.name: Farmako
company.shortDescription: Farmako is an application that delivers medicines and wellness products 24/7 along with digital healthcare services.
company.description: Farmako is a healthcare company that focuses on medicine delivery and digital health services. It provides medicine delivery in about 30 minutes. The company also offers tools that process prescriptions and support pharmacy operations. It starts as an AI-based EMR product for doctors and later shifts toward quick medicine delivery. It works with online consultations and pharmacy workflows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,438,901 to $17,403,669, a 2.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
